questions.prompt: Which description best captures globalization in relation to communication?

options.text: Increasing connections among people, places, institutions, technologies, and cultures across distance
The replacement of every local language with one universal language
A communication process that happens only inside one national border
The removal of all cultural differences from public messages

questions.explanation: Globalization involves intensified connections and flows. It does not guarantee that cultures become identical or that communication becomes equally accessible.
questions.misconception: Globalization means cultural sameness.

questions.prompt: What makes an interaction intercultural for purposes of communication analysis?

The interaction happens only when both people travel internationally
The interaction can be explained completely by each person's nationality

questions.explanation: Intercultural analysis focuses on meaningful differences in experience, expectations, or interpretation. Travel and nationality are neither necessary nor sufficient by themselves.
questions.misconception: Intercultural communication only happens between people from different countries.

questions.prompt: What is the best first move in this situation?

questions.prompt: Why can a language used as a lingua franca still reflect unequal power?

Shared use prevents any language from carrying history or identity
